purpose: Curated names for the clean CS5E engine: symbols, vtable slot names, struct fields, enums and native tables. Hand-maintained. Query and validate with tools/engine_map.py (check runs in the tests). Add what you verify; never guess. Classes and hooks live in the generated engine_classes.json and engine_hooks.json.

conventions.kind: function = entry point; site = address inside a function (hook or patch point); data = native image or BSS; ram = extension image or other RAM.
conventions.confidence: high = disassembly plus runtime observation or an exact structural read; medium = one of them, or donor-matched library code; low = hypothesis.
conventions.doc: Exact TECHNICAL heading that holds the evidence.
conventions.vslots: slot = byte offset from the class's first vtable, as native code indexes it. Name a slot on the class that declares it.
conventions.enums: "Name: note". The name before the colon labels handlers and digests.
conventions.tables: entries are verified against the ARM9 by check, except runtime tables.

CharacterStateMachine.doc: Engine map: RTTI classes, state tables and hook census (2026-11-14)
CharacterStateMachine.note: The "controller" of every character. Base fields read from SetState/Update/LateUpdate (high).
fields: 1 makes Update call SetState even for the same state
Zeroed by SetState, counted by LateUpdate
Owner actor (Spidey also keeps it at +0x44)
u32 default action per state: tables *::StateActions

SpideyStateMachine.note: Player controller, 0x98 bytes (heap block). Extends CharacterStateMachine. MiniBossStateMachine adds +0x98..+0xA8.
fields: Read by EvadeTransition (6 -> state 5); meaning not decoded
Weak reference to the last enemy hit (Webbed Fury recalls it)
0x40 dodging, 0x400 contact credit, 0xC00 air contact landed, 0x4000 string freeze, 0x8000 Scissor repeat
Refreshed to 10 each state-46 update; the node survives 10 updates

Actor.note: Common actor header. Spidey is 0xF4 bytes, NormalEnemy 0x8C, MiniBoss larger (heap blocks, runtime).
fields: Process part; native code calls every virtual through this one pointer
Weakable: other objects hold actor+4 as a weak reference
GameActor interface: pass actor+8 to ReceiveHit
1 while the animation allows a cancel
Spidey: weak reference chosen by SelectLiftable
Spidey: pointer to the ability words (aliases Stats+0x0C)

Motion.note: The 0x300-byte block at actor+0x30. Not a class: it embeds an SRTRenderableWrapper (+0x04) and a ShadowVolume (+0x188). "motion+0x310" in older notes is the next heap block, not a field.
fields: Back-link to the actor; used to reject freed copies
x, y probe (lab teleports write all three probes)
Used as the attacker part of a built hit
Bit 1 forces the action-record lookup on a repeated action
